_provenance: real_sample: 40 facts drawn at random (seed=7) from the live database's 2,547 quoted facts (see evaluation/results/evidence_sample_raw.json for the untouched pull); ground truth (should_validate) assigned by reading each quote/value pair directly against app.evidence's own definition of FACT_VALIDATED, not by asking any LLM. adversarial: constructed cases targeting a specific, already-suspected failure mode (wrong table column, a spurious value_numeric from a footnote/date/phone-number digit), run through the real app.evidence.check_evidence to confirm or refute the suspicion empirically.

real_sample.note: qualitative, quote is the statement itself

'29' from 'COP29' is not a real quantity at all (a conference name/id) -- the fact itself has no genuine numeric claim to be evidenced, so should_validate is false even though the mechanical check happens to find a matching digit
value is null; nothing numeric to validate, status is ungrounded (a different, earlier check) -- excluded from scoring
value_numeric=1.0 is a footnote marker ('1/'), not a real quantity -- no genuine numeric claim exists here to be evidenced
quote 'Subsidiary' is only 9 chars -- correctly too short/circular to independently verify
value_numeric=5.0 is a bond tenor label ('5y'), not a real measured quantity -- same class as 2838/2159
value is a citation string, not a real claim -- excluded from scoring (an extraction-scope issue, not evidence)
ungrounded (quote not found verbatim) -- a different, earlier check than value-support; excluded from this scoring

value_numeric=0.5 looks like a wrong percent/fraction normalization, but the raw value field '50 percent' does contain 50, which the quote also contains -- correctly validated under the check's own (value_numeric OR raw value) definition; the normalization mismatch is a separate, real finding, noted in the evaluation report
value_numeric=-25.0 comes from 'Sep-25' (a date fragment), not a real measured quantity -- same class as 2838/2159/1620
ungrounded, chart-axis value with an ellipsis-joined quote -- excluded from this scoring
value_numeric=-202.0 extracted from a FAX NUMBER '(202) 623-7201' -- not a quantity at all; the parenthesized-negative convention misfired on a phone number. A real, reportable limitation.
value=14 does NOT appear anywhere in quote 'Legal cases filed before various courts have been considered.' -- a real row-label-style miss, correctly demoted to quote_grounded
